title: The secret of Malenia's scarlet flower in Elden Ring
subject: malenia
description:
Should Finlay have left Malenia in Caelid? 👇

The Battle of Aeonia, the rot that destroyed Caelid, and the knight who carried Malenia home. Spoilers for Elden Ring.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FromSoftware or Bandai Namco Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Malenia has bloomed twice. A third bloom would make her a goddess.
The first bloom came in the swamps of Caelid, during her war with Starscourge Radahn.
Close to losing, she let the Scarlet Rot burst out of her like a giant red flower.
The rot swallowed the region. Radahn survived, but his mind didn't.
Malenia collapsed. A Cleanrot Knight named Finlay carried her on her back across the Lands Between to the Haligtree.
Fans believe the second bloom is the one players watch halfway through her boss fight.
That leaves one more flower between Malenia and godhood.
